name: Idea Behind
desc: Short animated explainers on the core idea behind classic algorithms — median-of-medians, Kruskal's MST, zero forcing, and more. Produced with Manim; designed to build intuition before the formal proof.

name: Theory Group
desc: Longer-form lecture recordings covering discrete structures, graph theory, and algorithms at university level. Companion to classroom teaching at LUMS and ITU.
